zh-Hans: 可在设置中启用实验性「按创建者」视图，按 AI Agent、项目和工作区浏览文件动态。
文件动态支持顶栏搜索和键盘浏览，窄窗口也能使用刷新和失败详情。
优化大目录索引的性能与内存占用，修复访达空格预览的焦点和关闭行为。
en: Enable the experimental By Creator view in Settings to browse file activity by AI agent, project and worktree.
Search from the activity toolbar and browse files with the keyboard. Refresh and scan failure details fit in narrow windows.
Large folders use less memory during indexing. Finder Space previews handle window focus and dismissal more reliably.
